ACCT1-QUIZ-Q04.answer: current ratio=1.58; assets exceed liabilities if ratio>1
solution_steps: Above 1 means current assets exceed current liabilities, not that all assets are cash.

ACCT1-QUIZ-Q05.answer: record unearned revenue first; recognize revenue as performance occurs
solution_steps: Cash receipt before performance does not by itself create earned revenue.
Record contract liability/unearned revenue, then recognize revenue as the performance obligation is satisfied.
